title: PR #54: feat(aurora): establish capability and tool execution foundation
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Summary

- add Rust capability, permission, approval, policy, and audit primitives
- add typed Aurora Tool, ToolRegistry, and Policy-gated ToolExecutor
- wire policy/tools crates into the workspace and Aurora runtime
- enforce scoped resources and declared permissions before execution
- record successful tool execution as an audit event

## Architecture

Aurora follows the frozen 1.0 boundary:

Agent → ToolRequest → PolicyEngine → Approval → ToolExecutor → Tool → Audit

Undeclared capabilities, mismatched permissions, out-of-scope resources, and missing explicit approval are denied.

This PR does not grant kernel, filesystem, chain, wallet, or release authority implicitly.
